subject: Control Plane: Identity Access Runbook & Cutover Schedule
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finbank.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: control plane IDP cutover & SCIM mapping

Hi Jasmine / Laura,

Thanks for taking time today. As we discussed on the call, FinBank is preparing to migrate our users to Redwood's private control plane (VPC) IDP integration. We need a tight runbook that covers:

- SAML/SSO metadata exchange and assertions (NameID, groups claim, eduPersonScopedAffiliation)
- SCIM schema mapping (users + groups), handling duplicates and email normalization
- Service account / IAM role mapping on the control plane side and least-privilege guidance
- A short cutover window with rollback steps and verification checks (login, token issuance, provisioning smoke tests)

Can you share a runbook draft and a proposed cutover date window (preferably a weekday evening PST)? Also please call out any SAML attributes we need to add on our IdP, and SCIM rate limits or group pagination expectations.

Attachments: idp-requirements.pdf (high-level list)

Olivia
Olivia Chen
IAM Program Lead, FinBank
olivia.chen@finbank.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: control plane IDP cutover & SCIM mapping

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. I attached a first-pass runbook and a proposed cutover schedule. High level summary below; runbook has step-by-step commands and verification scripts.

Proposed cutover window: Thu 2027-03-25 22:00-23:30 PST (rollout + 30m verification). Rollback plan: revert trust metadata on IdP + switch routing back to hosted control plane endpoint.

Key items called out:
- Metadata exchange: we'll provide the control-plane SP metadata (attached idp-metadata.xml) — FinBank must configure an SP trust and send us the IdP metadata (SAML SSO URL, x509 cert).
- SAML assertions: request NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress. Groups: we will accept groups claim as a JSON array in the `groups` attribute or standard 'eduPersonAffiliation'.
- SCIM: primary user mapping by mail attribute (email) with fallback to externalId. We'll send a SCIM schema mapping spreadsheet (scim-schema-mapping.xlsx). SCIM token will be a service account credential scoped to provisioning only.
- IAM roles & service accounts: propose names and least-privilege policy in runbook; control plane will create two roles for FinBank: `finbank-scim-provisioner` (SCIM write) and `finbank-read-only` (read-only for diagnostics).
- Rate limits: default SCIM rate limit is 60 req/min; recommend FinBank batch user provisioning to avoid 429s.

Next actions:
1) Olivia: confirm cutover window and whether FinBank can run a staging provisioning test by Wed 2027-03-24.
2) Markus: can you validate the IAM role ARN patterns and add any infra prechecks to the runbook?
3) Laura: I'll need a quick approval once we land the final schedule.

Attachments: cp-idp-runbook-v1.2.pdf, scim-schema-mapping.xlsx, idp-metadata.xml (generated SP metadata)

— Jasmine Liu
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: control plane IDP cutover & SCIM mapping

Jasmine — brief technical notes and required infra checks (copied into runbook, excerpt):

1) IAM roles and trust: we will provision the following on the private control plane (names are internal ids):
   - `redwood:role/finbank-scim-provisioner` — allowed actions: scim:User:Create, scim:User:Patch, scim:Group:Read, scim:Group:Patch
   - `redwood:role/finbank-read-only` — allowed actions: scim:User:Read, scim:Group:Read, auth:TokenInspect
   - Trust relationship: service-account credential (kid) issued per-customer; rotation window documented.

2) SAML assertion shape: we must receive `email` (mail) and either `groups` (JSON string) or `eduPersonScopedAffiliation`. If groups are large, FinBank must enable group filtering (we support `groups` with pagination).

3) SCIM: confirm attribute mapping behaviors for `externalId` collisions and group membership reconciliation. Runbook includes a dry-run flag `--scim-dry-run` for initial sync.

4) Network / IP allowlist: FinBank will need to allow outbound traffic to our SCIM endpoint over TLS (TCP 443) from their provisioning IPs. We'll provide EGRESS IPs the day before cutover.

5) Observability hooks: add a smoke check post-provisioning to validate token issuance for 3 test users and a sample login flow.

I also added a short play of CLI commands for the ops team to verify role bindings and a troubleshooting checklist for common SCIM 429/500 responses.

— Markus
Engineering (Runtime & Infra), Redwood Inference

Hi Jasmine / Olivia,

Quick note from the IdP side: we reviewed the SP metadata and have two recommendations before cutover: 

- SCIM rate-limiting: default Okta SCIM connector will batch group membership updates; when customers send large group payloads enable `pagination=true` on the SCIM request and avoid >100 groups per call.
- Metadata validity: ensure the SP x509 cert in idp-metadata.xml is valid for at least 7 days past the cutover (we see outages when certs expire during handover).

I've attached a sanitized idp-metadata.xml (cert block truncated) and a short note on SCIM pagination. If you want, we can run a connectivity check from Okta to the control-plane SCIM endpoint during your staging test.

Best,
Okta Support
support@okta.com

Thanks everyone — I've reviewed the runbook and both the security and infra teams have signed off on the plan (summaryed below). Approving the proposed cutover window Thu 2027-03-25 22:00-23:30 PST. Final prechecks checklist:

- FinBank: confirm IdP metadata and enable SCIM pagination in staging by Wed 2027-03-24 EOD
- Redwood: provide final egress IP list and scoped service-account key + rotate token TTL to 2h for cutover window
- Ops: ensure smoke tests in runbook pass (3 test users login & token issuance)

If the staging test passes, proceed with cutover. If we hit >10% provisioning errors during the first 15 minutes, we trigger rollback.

I'll attach this approval to INF-718 and notify CS to prep the customer comms.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
